title: Lithe Maven Local Configuration v1
description: Machine-local Maven selection for one workspace, stored in the project's .lithe/maven.local.json. It is the project-local layer of the Maven settings.xml / local-repository override; the global defaults live in the application settings file. Never share this document: it carries absolute machine paths. Note that the shared document layer preserves keys it does not model, so a hand-edited file may legitimately contain more than this schema describes.
